description: The in-vitro CLint an assay must read for a compound to reach a target plasma clearance (mL/min/kg): calc_clhep run backwards, e.g. to set a CLint cut-off for a screening cascade. Needs fu,mic and fu,p; refuses a target at or above the liver blood flow ceiling and returns that ceiling. Uncorrected IVIVE, so no error band.

assay_type.description: Assay the CLint is for; sets its units (µL/min/mg protein or µL/min/10⁶ cells).
assay_type.title: Assay Type

fu_mic.description: Unbound fraction in the incubation (0–1) the CLint would be measured at.
fu_mic.title: Fu Mic

rb.description: Blood-to-plasma concentration ratio; raises the plasma CL ceiling (Qh × Rb).
rb.title: Rb

species.description: Species whose liver blood flow and scaling factors apply.
species.title: Species

target_clp.description: Plasma clearance to aim for (mL/min/kg). Must be below hepatic blood flow × Rb.
target_clp.title: Target Clp

name: target_clint
